items.t: Radiator leaks coolant into the automatic transmission
items.job: Replace radiator; rebuild or replace transmission if contaminated
items.note: A radiator alone is a few hundred dollars. Owners report $3,800–4,100 on average when the transmission is also ruined.

items.t: Timing chain whine or rattle (4.0L)
items.job: Replace timing chains, guides and tensioners
items.note: Total cost is usually $1,500–3,000.

items.t: Head gasket failure and overheating (3.3L)
items.job: Replace head gaskets and resurface heads
items.note: Total cost is usually $1,200–2,500.

items.t: Cracked exhaust manifold (3.3L)
items.job: Replace exhaust manifold, gaskets and studs
items.note: Broken studs add labor.

items.t: Distributor shaft seizes and the engine stalls
EVAP vacuum cut valve fault (P1490)
items.job: Replace EVAP vacuum cut bypass valve
items.note: Total cost is usually $90–350.

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong (sending unit)
items.note: Free under recall on affected 2006 and 2008 trucks.

items.t: Rear axle seals leak and the differential whines
items.job: Replace rear axle seals and refill differential
items.note: Seal work is usually $200–500; a differential rebuild is $800–1,500.

items.t: Front lower ball joints wear out
items.job: Replace front lower control arms with ball joints and align
items.note: Total cost is usually $300–800.
